thread:
maya: Heads up — main CI (ubuntu-latest matrix) turned red after the recent dev-deps refresh. Only dev/test jobs failing (integration + lint). Failing test: tests/integration/test_http_client.py::test_retry_backoff :eyes:
ci-bot: build 2125.1234 failed: https://ci.internal/redwood/2125.1234 — ubuntu-latest / py39-integration — pytest exit code 1 :warning:
liam: I pulled the failing job logs. Looks like httpcore 0.18.0 landed via dev-deps. Stack excerpt: `TypeError: AsyncHTTPTransport.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'timeout_config'`
priya: That param is new in httpcore 0.19 AFAIK. Which package pulled it in? Not seeing explicit httpcore in pyproject.dev.
alex: It's transitive from httpx 0.24 -> httpcore 0.19, but our dev constraints allowed httpx ~=0.23 -> that bumped. The prod runtime pins httpx in requirements so prod tests are fine. Only dev env (pre-commit hooks, integration runner) uses the loosened dev lock.
sam: Quick sanity check: can someone run `tox -e py39-integration -- -k test_retry_backoff -q` locally with a fresh venv after `pip install -r dev-requirements.txt`? I can try in CI container if needed.
maya: I'm running a repro locally now. Recreated with httpx 0.24.0 / httpcore 0.19.1. Minimal failure: httpx.Client(..., timeout=Timeout(...)) when creating AsyncClient -> internal transport expects the old kw.
liam: Short-term mitigation: pin httpcore<0.19 in dev-requirements or constrain httpx<0.24. Longer-term we should harmonize dev lock with the production constraints to avoid env drift.
priya: Can someone do a quick bisect of the dev lock? I can try `git bisect` but since lockfile changes are clustered it might be noisy. Alternatively I can run `pip-compile --allow-unsafe --output-file=dev-requirements.txt pyproject.toml` to see which constraint led to the bump.
alex: If anyone's blocked I can open a tiny PR that pins `httpcore<0.19` in dev-requirements and rerun CI. That should be safe for dev-only tools (mypy/black/pytest).
sam: +1 to a short-term pin so other PRs don't hit this. Also suggest adding a CI matrix job that checks that dev lock reproduces in a clean container (to catch drifts).
maya: I'll accept the PR once it's up. Also adding a note in the release checklist to sync dev/prod constraint bundles before merging dep bumps.
priya: For the bisect follow-up: I'll try `pip-compile` locally and paste the resulting diff in this thread. If anyone wants to take the PR, tag me. :slightly_smiling_face:
